title.en: Failure domain in a placement rule

concept.hr: Isti podaci uz type host i uz type rack, pa se izgubi ormar
concept.en: Same data, rule by host vs by rack; then lose a rack

summary.hr: Promijeni jednu riječ u CRUSH pravilu pa izgubi ormar: uz type host dvije kopije dijele ormar i 453 od 2048 PG-ova staje, uz type rack nijedan.
summary.en: Change one word in a CRUSH rule, then lose a rack: by host two copies can share a rack and 453 of 2048 PGs stop; by rack, none do.
